stem.text: An autocatalytic reaction is a reaction in which one of the products catalyses the reaction.
Which curve would be obtained if the rate of an autocatalytic reaction is plotted against time?

A.alt: Graph of rate against time: rate rises steadily from zero, then levels off at a constant value.

B.alt: Graph of rate against time: rate rises slowly at first, then steeply, then levels off at a constant value.

C.alt: Graph of rate against time: rate rises from zero to a maximum, then falls.

D.alt: Graph of rate against time: rate starts at a maximum and falls steadily over time.
